Name: Collective Channeler
Information:
**Collective Channeler**

Channelers of the Collective are enforcers who use advanced equipment engineered using research into thesite. Their main weapon is a crystal lance spawned from a hidden matrix containing an almost invisibly small shard of thesite. This lance can be deployed or hidden at will with no evidence remaining, making it a stealthy weapon for agents blending into crowds. Their suits also contain small generators that can produce enough energy to hover for very short bursts, allowing the channeler to engage in aerial combat if needed.

traits.name: Crystal Rewrite (2/Rest)
traits.description: When the channeler fails an attack or saving throw, it can roll a d6 and add it to the result, possibly changing the outcome. It may only do so once per roll.

traits.name: Crystal Smite (2/Rest)
traits.description: When the channeler hits with a melee weapon attack, it may force its target to make a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw, taking 22 (4d10) radiant damage and is knocked prone on a failed save, or half as much damage and isn’t knocked prone on a success. A single creature can only be targeted by this effect once per turn.

traits.name: Unimpeachable Logic
traits.description: The channeler has advantage on saving throws made to resist being charmed or enraged.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The channeler makes two weapon attacks.

actions.name: Pseudothesite Lance
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (1d12 + 4) piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) radiant damage.

bonus_actions.name: Thesite Recharge (Recharge 5-6)
bonus_actions.description: The channeler regains all spent uses of its Crystal Rewrite, Crystal Smite, or Crystal Shield.

reactions.name: Crystal Shield (2/Rest)
reactions.description: In response to taking damage, the channeler may give themselves resistance to the triggering damage type (or types) until the start of their next turn, including against the triggering attack.
